table: FY2016 Collection of Taxes — Receivables Summary, June 30, 2016
proved: No total or stated identity appears anywhere in the boxes given for this page — no GRAND TOTAL line, no row that sums the others. Nothing to check the rows against; proved = none.
note: Row placement was done by y-banding (half the ~0.025 row pitch), not by row label proximity alone, and this moved one figure: the REFUNDS value "$276.06" at y=0.451 sits inside SEWER USER CHARGES's band (label y=0.449), not WATER USER CHARGES's (label y=0.474, whose own band tops out at y=0.461) — an earlier read-by-eye would have misassigned it. Two things I could not resolve cleanly: (1) The header row prints "COMMITTMENTS ADJUSTMENTS" as one OCR box at x=0.555, but the data clearly needs two columns there — every row with activity in that region shows two independent, differently-valued figures at x≈0.573 and x≈0.688 (e.g. WATER USER CHARGES: $27,618.93 and $150.00 in the same row). I split it into "COMMITTMENTS" and "ADJUSTMENTS" in that left-to-right order since both are complete, correctly-ordered words matching two really-distinct columns — not a proportional/character split of a phrase — but the printed page never labels these as two separate boxes, so treat the individual names as inferred from a merged header, only the fact that two columns exist as certain. (2) MEADOW WOODS WATER BETTERMENT prints as a single OCR box "MEADOW WOODS WATER BETTERMEI $1,070,392.14" with only the label's x (0.215) given — no independent x for the figure itself, so I cannot place it by nearest-centre as the rule requires. I put it under FORWARD by analogy with the adjacent SEWER BETTERMENT row (also a large balance in that column), but this one is a guess, not a placement. Also: the label-column header reads "FISCAL YEAR" but every row it sits above is a receivable-type name (DEFERRED PROPERTY TAX, SEWER BETTERMENT, etc.), never a year — the header word is printed as given, but it does not describe what the column actually holds. Finally, the rightmost data at x≈0.795 (REFUNDS) may not be the true right edge of the printed table; the boxes provided stop there, so if the source page has further columns (abatements, collections, balance outstanding — typical of this report type) they are not represented here.
